name: design-taste-frontend
title_zh: 先拆模板再动手的落地页前端审美师
tagline_zh: 它先读你的 brief，再推断设计方向，而不是套现成组件库。改版先审计再动手，交付前有严格预检，落地页、作品集。
tagline_en: Reads your brief, infers design direction, ships interfaces that don't look templated. Audits before redesigns.
desc_en: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.
why_zh: 机制上先做设计方向推断，再写代码；改版强制 audit-first，杜绝上来就改样式。预检拦截模板感。
why_en: Infers design direction before writing code; audit-first on redesigns prevents style-patch chaos. Pre-flight check catches.
limit_zh: 只覆盖前端视觉层，不碰后端与交互逻辑；需要你提供 brief 或现有页面，否则它无从推断方向；预检只查模板痕迹。
limit_en: Frontend visual layer only; no backend or interaction logic. Requires a brief or existing page to infer direction. Pre-flight checks template tells.
title_en: Frontend taste layer that kills template look
